periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation, approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal axis, slanting upwards and outwards from the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval morphology with a high aspect ratio; the vertical length of the patch exceeds the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward and lateral tapering, with the lowest point of the patch shifted significantly below the geometric center.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Moderate separation distance between the black pinna regions, roughly 1.5 times the width of a single ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, continuous semicircular curvature at the top boundary of both ears.
